Hi Aldo,

Thanks for following up, and sorry you've had to chase this.

Your order Shop···· is still showing as paid and unshipped on our side, so nothing has gone out and nothing will. The cancellation and refund are with Abel and Georges, and a colleague is picking it up today.

It's the full $869.00 back to the card you paid with, no fee, since nothing shipped. Card refunds land 3 to 5 business days after they issue it, and you'll get the confirmation by email as soon as it's done.

Nothing more needed from you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
